newsitem.title: CANADA: Prime-Link enters special warrant deal.
newsitem.headline: Prime-Link enters special warrant deal.

text.p: Prime-Link Group Ltd said on Monday it entered into a letter of agreement that will see Newcrest Capital Inc underwrite a private placement of six million special warrants at C$0.50 a warrant, a Prime-Link statment said.
Gross proceeds from the placement should be C$3 million.
Each special warrant will allow its holder to acquire one Class "A" common share of Prime-Link at no additional cost.
The offering was scheduled to close on or about Nov 12 and was subject to regulatory approval.
Proceeds will be applied to Prime-Link's working capital.
Prime-Link is a Calgary-based long-haul transport, storage and distribution firm listed on the Alberta Stock Exchange.
